findings.one_line: The stated index ranges do not ensure a nonempty model: any member requires kappa|I|<=1 and R_f>=(2B_A)^(-1/2) (with further structural/Sobolev compatibility), yet no compatibility/nonemptiness condition is imposed; the advertised uniform inference can therefore be vacuous.
ass:unconfoundedness is inert under ass:structural-response-surface: Y(a)=h(a,X,V) on one common event and V independent of A given X already imply A independent of Y(a) given X for every a.

The identification-of-limits step explicitly invokes lem:moment-derived-local-modulus, but that node is absent from depends_on; add it (or reproduce its moment calculation from def:exact-projected-class in this proof).
